name: dark-factory
description: Curie's default dark factory agent: one labelled GitHub issue in, one reviewed pull request or one stated reason out. One agent reads the issue through the platform's get_issue tool, pins acceptance criteria, plans, gets the plan reviewed by an Opus plan-reviewer subagent, writes a failing test where feasible, implements and runs the repository's own checks, gets the diff reviewed by an Opus diff-reviewer subagent (each loop capped at 3 rounds, enforced by a hook), and publishes through Curie's built-in approval-gated publication tool within the 10800 second (3 hour) execution bound.
